newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BACK RECALLED TO ENGLAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BACK RECALLED TO ENGLAND SQUAD.

text.p: Flanker Neil Back, who had a storming game in his club Leicester's crushing defeat of Toulouse in last weekend's European Cup semifinal, was recalled to England's international squad on Wednesday for the first time since World Cup 95 .
Back was included in a 30-man training squad for the start of England's preparations for their defence of the Five Nations Championship.
England's first match is at Twickenham against Scotland on February 1.

Back was not considered for England's international against Argentina last month because he had returned to the game only in November after completing a six-month suspension for pushing over the referee during the English club cup final.

But Back has rediscovered his all-action form recently and, along with Richard Hill, the uncapped Saracen, is a candidate for the open-side position, if manager Jack Rowell decides to opt for a specialist there.
If Rowell gives the spot to Back or Hill, one of Lawrence Dallaglio, Tim Rodber or Chris Sheasby will miss out.
Rowell has retained the 21-man squad who were on duty in the narrow win over Argentina and also called up Back's Leicester colleagues centre Will Greenwood and prop Darren Garforth.

Full-back Tim Stimpson and winger Adedayo Adebayo, who missed the Argentina test with injury, are also recalled as are fly-half Paul Grayson and lock Garath Archer, who figured in last winter's Five Nation's winning team.
With England not involved in the first round of matches on January 18, Rowell will not need to name his final XV until much later in the month.
Full-backs: Nick Beal (Northampton), Jon Callard (Bath), Tim Stimpson (Newcastle).
Wings: Jon Sleightholme (Bath), Tony Underwood (Newcastle), Adedayo Adebayo (Bath).
Centres: Will Carling (Harlequins), Phil de Glanville (Bath), Will Greenwood (Leicester), Jeremy Guscott (Bath).
Fly-halfs: Mike Catt (Bath), Alex King (Wasps), Paul Grayson (Northampton).
Props: Graham Rowntree (Leicester), Jason Leonard (Harlequins), Rob Hardwick (Coventry), Darren Garforth (Leicester).
Locks: Martin Johnson (Leicester), Simon Shaw (Bristol), Garath Archer (Newcastle).
Back row: Tim Rodber (Northampton), Lawrence Dallaglio (Wasps), Chris Sheasby (Wasps), Neil Back (Leicester), Richard Hill (Saracens), Ben Clarke (Richmond).
